fixed_reference_offline_eval.description: S1 and S2 offline metrics must be compared on exactly the same S1 validation subset. The full S2 512-game validation metrics are diagnostics only and are not used for G4 offline movement.

offline_movement.description: S2 must show a non-degenerate learning signal on the fixed S1 reference subset relative to S1. These are diagnostic gates only and are not strength evidence.
offline_movement.bps_definition: Relative improvement/regression for lower-is-better metrics uses S1 as the denominator: delta_bps = (S1 - S2) / S1 * 10000. Positive delta_bps means improvement. Top-1 uses absolute differences.
offline_movement.pass_condition: At least one offline metric must meet its minimum improvement threshold on the fixed S1 reference subset, and no offline metric may exceed its maximum regression threshold.

competitive_movement.description: Fresh multi-seed Arena screen using five 2-agent pairwise EvaluationPlans bundled by benchmarks/m24-s2-arena-screen-v1.bundle.json. All plans share the same 32 fresh seeds and timeouts, and each expands to exactly 64 matches (32 seeds x 2 seat rotations).

arena_screen_bundle.required_semantics: Five plans, each with exactly 2 agents, same game_seeds 300001..300032, same timeouts 5000/10000/2000, and 2 cyclic seat rotations per seed.

runtime_identity.s2_checkpoint_rule: See competitive_movement.materialization_contract: placeholder __M24_S2_CHECKPOINT_HASH__ is the only allowed substitution point for the formal M24-S2 checkpoint semantic hash.

statistics.pairwise_lower_bound_method: reuse existing effective-splendor-promotion-v1 deterministic integer one-sided Hoeffding
statistics.score_definition: win=1.0, tie=0.5, loss=0.0 per completed match

primary.pass_condition: min pairwise score lower bound >= 100 bps using the frozen Hoeffding contract

anchors.description: Anchor regression uses pairwise center score bps, not lower bounds, because S1/S2 anchor comparisons are calibration deltas.
anchors.pass_condition: delta >= -200 bps for both M07 and heuristic anchors

materialization_contract.description: The three S2-containing Arena plans are frozen templates. A realized plan may only replace the exact placeholder in the m24-s2-candidate --checkpoint-hash argument with the formal M24-S2 checkpoint semantic hash. No other field may change.
materialization_contract.allowed_difference: m24-s2-candidate.command.args[--checkpoint-hash + 1] changes from __M24_S2_CHECKPOINT_HASH__ to the formal M24-S2 checkpoint semantic hash.
materialization_contract.validation_required: Each realized plan must deserialize as EvaluationPlanV1, validate, expand to 64 matches, and differ from its frozen template only by the checkpoint hash substitution.
materialization_contract.s1_only_plans: S1 vs M07 and S1 vs heuristic are exact plans and do not require materialization.

decision.pass_means: S2 shows a non-degenerate offline learning signal on the fixed S1 reference subset, a positive competitive movement against S1 by the frozen Hoeffding lower bound, and no anchor regression beyond 200 bps; S3 may be considered.
decision.fail_means: S2 fails offline movement, S2 vs S1 competitive movement, or anchor regression; stop M24 scaling and do not auto-authorize M25.
